definition: Communicative Agents for Software Development, an approach simulating a virtual software company run by interacting autonomous AI agents.
details: Communicative Agents for Software Development, an approach simulating a virtual software company run by interacting autonomous AI agents.

explainer.lead: ChatDev, short for Communicative Agents for Software Development, simulates a software company whose work is carried out by autonomous AI agents communicating with one another. It matters because it explores whether coordinated agents can handle software development as a collaborative process rather than as a single prompt-and-response task.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a pretend software company where every worker is an AI. Instead of one AI doing everything alone, the workers talk to each other to coordinate the job. ChatDev is a way of exploring this kind of teamwork for making software.
tiers.practitioner: ChatDev frames development as communication among autonomous agents within a simulated software company, rather than relying on one isolated model response. An engineer evaluating the approach should inspect both the resulting software artifacts and the agent interactions, since more communication does not by itself establish correctness or reliability.
tiers.paperLevel: ChatDev models software development as a multi-agent process: given a development task T, autonomous agents A interact through communication to coordinate work and produce development output Y. The central abstraction is a virtual software company organized around interacting agents. Agent communication alone does not guarantee correct software, so the outputs still require evaluation.

explainer.example: For a request to build a small to-do list application, the agents could exchange messages about the requested work and coordinate their development activities instead of one agent answering in isolation. The final application and its associated artifacts would then need to be checked against the request.
explainer.intuition: A software project normally involves communication as well as individual work. ChatDev transfers that idea to AI by making autonomous agents interact inside a simulated software company.
howItWorks: A software-development goal is given to the simulated company.
Autonomous AI agents take part in the development process.
The agents communicate to coordinate their work.
Their coordinated activity produces software-development output.
explainer.whyItMatters: ChatDev provides a way to study software development as coordinated multi-agent work. It also highlights communication as a design element in systems that aim to automate development tasks.
misconceptions: It is not a human software company; the company is a simulation populated by AI agents.
More agent communication does not automatically mean better or correct software.
It is an approach to organizing development, not a guarantee that human review becomes unnecessary.

diagram.caption: ChatDev coordinates autonomous agents through communication inside a simulated software company.
